meta.themes: Frontier Models Cut Costs, Agent Interfaces Expand, AI Infrastructure Scales, Governance Meets Real-World Risk

news.title: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Sol and Luna with 50% lower API prices
news.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Sol and Luna with stronger agentic, coding, factuality, and computer-use performance while cutting API prices by 50% from GPT-5.6 promotional levels.

news.title: Anthropic introduced Claude Opus 5.5 for agentic coding and knowledge work
news.summary: Anthropic said Claude Opus 5.5 matches Claude Fable 5.1 on most work, costs 40% less to run than Opus 5, and improves resistance to prompt injection and unsafe actions.

news.title: Google introduced Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar
news.summary: Google introduced Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar, adding a near-real-time visual presence to its conversational AI for more expressive multimodal interactions.

news.title: Microsoft rebuilt Copilot around coding, agents, and Office apps
news.summary: Microsoft added a coding tool and an always-on agent to Copilot while embedding Word, Excel, and PowerPoint directly into the assistant for in-context office work.

news.title: Meta brought its Muse personal AI agent to smart glasses
news.summary: Meta announced that Muse will connect to its AI glasses to manage tasks and long-term goals hands-free, alongside new Ray-Ban Meta Audio glasses and a broader frame lineup.

news.title: Snorkel AI raised $350 million at a $3.5 billion valuation
news.summary: Snorkel AI raised $350 million as demand from frontier labs for complex training data and simulated environments pushed its annualized revenue run-rate to about $350 million.

news.title: Alibaba unveiled the Zhenwu V900 AI chip and a 20GW cloud target
news.summary: Alibaba said its Zhenwu V900 delivers three times its predecessor's performance and can scale to 500,000-chip clusters as the company targets more than 20GW of cloud capacity by 2032.

news.title: Google detailed Project Suncatcher's path to AI infrastructure in space
news.summary: Google described Project Suncatcher tests for putting machine-learning infrastructure in space, including AI-chip cooling, radiation resilience, and hardware survival challenges.

news.title: US appeals court upheld the Pentagon's Anthropic blacklist
news.summary: A US appeals court upheld the Pentagon's designation of Anthropic as a national-security supply-chain risk, extending a dispute over military access and Claude's safety guardrails.

news.title: GitHub expanded Copilot's JetBrains agent controls and shared skills
news.summary: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains 1.18.0 added AI-assisted tool approvals, better agent-conversation controls, shared organizational skills and instructions, and Codex plan review.

news.title: GitHub added OpenTelemetry support to the Copilot app
news.summary: The GitHub Copilot app now supports enterprise-managed OpenTelemetry configuration so teams can observe how agents interact with models and tools.

news.title: Cloudflare launched Turnstile Spin for agent-assisted security setup
news.summary: Cloudflare's Turnstile Spin lets developers use their preferred AI coding agent to add required server-side verification and avoid incomplete anti-bot deployments.
